messages:
Anya: Quick sync — launch metrics look fine but we're getting a cluster of customer asks and a few regressions. I want a proposal: do we ship a small 'patchband' sprint (3-day hotfix bundle) or fold everything into the next feature wave? Link to ticket: https://tickets.redwood/4521
Samir: What regressions? can you list priorities? :thinking_face:
Anya: Two production bugs (high latency for long prompts, tokenization edge-case causing truncation), plus 6 customer feature asks where 3 are small UX tweaks, 2 are new metric exports, 1 is a data retention policy change.
Miguel: Latency bug looks like model routing fallbacks hitting a slower variant when kv-cache miss rate spikes. I can try an emergency canary for routing policy.
Lina: If we do a patch sprint we should reserve capacity. Dedicated pools can handle but need autoscale tweak. Also ops impact during business hours — prefer overnight deploy.
Priya: From design POV the small UX tweaks are low risk and quick (0.5–1d each), they'd improve conversion for onboarding customers.
Jordan: If we batch small UX fixes with the bug fixes we can release a single minor version. Estimate: bugs = 3 dev-days, UX tweaks = 4 dev-days, metrics/export work = 6 dev-days, retention = 2 dev-days.
Anya: Customer asks: customer A (enterprise) asked for retention window change urgently, they have compliance deadline EOW. That's the highest priority.
Samir: Suggestion: do a 3-day patchband that covers the two prod bugs + retention policy change. Defer metrics exports to next sprint. UX tweaks — can we bugfix-sprite them in the patch if dev bandwidth leftover?
Miguel: Agree. I'll prioritize the routing fix and put a temporary routing fallback to avoid the slower variant.
Lina: I'm fine with overnight deploy. Ops will run the scale increase 01:00 UTC. Need SIG pages and rollback plan.
Priya: We'll deliver one UX tweak (onboarding copy/CTA) in the patch since it's tiny and high impact.
Jordan: Cool. I'll create a small branch + changelog. Proposed deploy steps:
```
git checkout -b patch/1743216789-patchband
apply routing-fix
apply retention-config
run e2e smoke
deploy-canary
monitor 2h
promote
```
Samir: Add QA checklist: smoke tests + tokenization fuzz test + perf baseline.
Anya: I'll notify customers and CS, and schedule a 30min post-deploy check-in tomorrow 09:30 PST. @deploy-bot schedule canary for 01:00 UTC
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 01:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
Lina: Ops note — make sure to bump autoscale min gpupool by +20% during canary.
Miguel: I'll keep an eye on KV miss metric. If miss_rate > 5% revert routing change.
Samir: We should also add a follow-up story to track UX tweaks if any regressions appear — backlog ticket created: https://tickets.redwood/4589
Anya: Thanks everyone. Summary: 3-day patchband includes two prod bugs + retention change + one small UX tweak. Metrics exports deferred. Post-deploy retrospective Wed. :thumbsup:
